mods.name: BTW Music Player
mods.description: A dynamic music engine for Better Than Wolves CE. Create custom Music Packs where music plays contextually based on dimension, biome, time of day, combat, boss battles, and more. Features smooth transitions and an intelligent combat music system.

releases.notes:
Changelog:
- **Update to BTW CE 3.0.0 full release**
- **Dynamic "Now Playing" Notifications**: A stylish pop-up now slides in from the right whenever a new song starts. It displays both the **Song Title** and the **Music Pack Name**.
	- **Custom Song Titles**: Added support for an optional "title" field in songs.json. If you don't provide a title, the mod will gracefully fallback to the filename.
	- **Full Control**: Added a new toggle in the configuration menu (the gear icon) to enable or disable notifications based on your preference.
	- **Under the Hood**: Smooth slide-in/out animations, dynamic width adjustment for long titles, and full backwards compatibility with older music packs.
- **New condition:** "is_low_health": true inside your songs.json. You can now define sounds (like a heartbeat loop) that play **simultaneously** with your background or combat music when you drop to 5 hearts or less. It adds immersion without interrupting the main soundtrack!
- **Smart Playlist Logic:** The system now works like a deck of cards. Tracks are shuffled globally at launch, and the mod remembers exactly what has already been played during your session.
- **Jukebox Fix:** Inserting a music disc now correctly pauses the mod's music. Your background tracks will automatically resume once the Jukebox stops playing.

releases.notes:
Changelog:
- Main Menu Music: Added full support for custom music in the Main Menu, World Selection, and Options screens using the new "is_menu": true condition.
- Global Condition Toggles: A new in-game configuration menu ("Song Conditions") allows you to globally enable or disable specific rules (e.g., you can now turn off all Combat or Biome music with one click).
- Seamless Pause: Music continues to play uninterrupted when the game is paused (ESC menu).
- Technical Improvements: Refactored the sound engine hook (runGameLoop) to ensure reliable playback across all game states.

releases.notes:
- Resolved a critical crash that occurred when changing Resource Packs (SoundSystem NullPointerException).
- New configuration sliders in the in-game menu for **Crossfade Duration** and **Cave Depth**.
- Cave detection logic no longer requires a block overhead. Cave music now triggers strictly based on the configured Y-level (Default: 60), allowing cave themes to play in deep, open ravines.
- Biome variants (e.g., forest_hills, desert_hills, extreme_hills_edge) are now automatically mapped to their parent biome. You no longer need to define rules for every sub-biome!
- Rivers and Beaches are now considered "transparent". Music from the previous biome (e.g., Forest) will continue to play while crossing a river, preventing annoying interruptions.
- The in-game configuration menu now checks if the .ogg files defined in songs.json actually exist and are valid. Music Packs with missing files will be marked in red with an error count.

releases.notes:
Say goodbye to manually editing config files! This update brings a full In-Game Configuration Menu to make your life easier.

What's New:
⚙️ In-Game Settings: Click the new Gear Icon next to the Music slider in Options to access the mod configuration.
📂 Music Pack Manager: Browse your installed Music Packs with a new interface. The mod now validates your packs automatically (Green = Ready, Red = Error).
🚀 Quality of Life: Added an "Open Folder" button to quickly access your musicpacks directory directly from the game.
🎚️ Hot-Swapping: Change the loading mode (Single/All), adjust Context Delay, or toggle Debug Logging instantly—no game restart required!

releases.notes:
Changelog:
- Terminology Change: Renamed "Sound Packs" to "Music Packs" to better reflect the mod's purpose.
- New Folder Structure: The mod now loads music from the /musicpacks folder instead of /soundpacks.
- Configuration Update: Configuration keys have been updated (e.g., musicpack_loading_mode). The mod will generate a new config file.
- Improved Logging: Optimized debug logging. The console now displays a concise summary of why songs were skipped (Trace Log) instead of spamming individual errors for every file.

⚠️ Action Required:
- Rename your .minecraft/soundpacks folder to .minecraft/musicpacks.
- Delete the old .minecraft/config/btw-music-player.cfg file so a new one can be generated.

readmeSummary: BTW Music Player is a dynamic music engine created as an addon for the Better Than Wolves Community Edition 3.0.0 mod for Minecraft 1.6.4.
